title: It's Just OK
text: It's Just OK. The matt is ok, it's biggest issue is that it has no real slant. The water tends to stagnate on the matt and not drain off. If you have a sink with a lip around the edge of the counter, this is even a bigger issue and the water will not drain at all. If you have a granite counter top with the sink on the inside, it performs better but still stagnates.
